Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34572
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1559

## What changed

- fold HiCache prefetch readiness into the PP bootstrap consensus
- make PP0 freeze sequenced immutable `(good, bad)` decisions
- apply each decision exactly once and forward it unchanged across stages
- order AbortReq handling relative to committed bootstrap decisions
- retain local KV failures as proposals until a PP-wide bad decision commits
- fail immediately on sequence gaps, conflicting payloads, and local finalize failure after a good commit
- add regressions for abort storms, local failure races, duplicate/gap handling, immutable forwarding, finalize failure, and HiCache readiness boundaries

## Reproduction and validation

Failing-before on base `358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365`:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-453c3e26ad79/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_abort_consensus.py
```

The base could not collect the issue regression because `PPBootstrapDecision` was absent. Direct source inspection additionally showed uncovered local `KVPoll.Failed` mutating a single stage's queue and the return ring forwarding each stage's locally applied result.

Passing-after:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-453c3e26ad79/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_abort_consensus.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_hicache_prefetch_consensus.py
```

Result: 24 passed, with 4 additional parameterized subtests passed.

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-453c3e26ad79/venv/bin/python -m py_compile \
  python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler_pp_mixin.py \
  python/sglang/srt/managers/io_struct.py
```

Result: passed.

Raw output and claim details are under `reports/j-453c3e26ad79/`.

## Limitations

The assigned environment has one gfx950 GPU, so it cannot reproduce the reported PP=8 disaggregated Mooncake topology. I did not claim a full-model, multi-node, NCCL-watchdog, 32K shared-prefix, or seven-hour soak reproduction. The deterministic tests validate the queue and protocol invariants; they do not validate semantic model accuracy or production-topology transport behavior. No native code changed, so no native rebuild was required.
